description:
Current scope: User scope correction: PR5 delivers the foundation. Mattermost adapter publication/pinning and full real-provider partial-upload verification move to PR6 with AttachDocuments (zaq-pi3.7), using existing zaq-h2i.4.3. This supersedes earlier descriptions/comments making a published Mattermost fix a PR5 prerequisite. PR5 still completes chat boundary plumbing, SMTP, Channels.Api wiring, Channels -> Engine reporting and the grouped-failure modal. Use controlled external adapter-boundary fixtures for unavailable operations while exercising real internal planning/preparation/execution/reporting; verify current packages fail safely where unsupported. Never advertise unsupported production capabilities, guess partial-upload identities, edit ignored deps or substitute local dependency pins. Full provider compatibility must be verified in PR6 before claiming Mattermost attachment readiness. This scope correction does not authorize commits, pushes or dependency publication.

Functional specifications / files: focused tests under test/zaq/channels, test/zaq/engine and existing delivery visibility LiveView/component suites; docs/services/channels.md and engine.md. Exercise real API->planner/preparation/executor->bridge->external transport->DeliveryConfirmation->Engine->history projection. Document approved contracts and supported adapter limits, not speculative PR6/7 behavior.
Tests before implementation: scripted local Mattermost HTTP and SMTP journey, multiple groups/upload batches, actual bytes/IDs, exact MIME ceiling and continuation overflow, abort/continue, root promotion, timeout/uncertainty, failed-only modal data, all files unusable text fallback, exact actor/connector scope, provider success with reporting outage, edits without duplicates, concurrent attempt isolation. Properties for stable indices, once-only effects and confirmation preservation. Reuse existing test/support helpers; do not import reference fixtures with old Outgoing.Delivery.
Branches: successful/partial/failed/unconfirmed; text parity; unsupported declaration behavior; failure matrix across acquisition/prepare/upload/send/edit/history.
Mocking: external network only; internal domain calls real. Runtime config per attempt; Sandbox ownership explicit.
Documentation: module docs and owning service guides; record validation and reuse audit here.
Action reuse: verification of shared implementation and existing events, no new executable operation. Run issue validation per workflow, existing required E2E, review diff for scope/privacy/unused code. New feature E2E waits for human UX gate.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

PR #970 regression coverage addendum (2026-11-27): retain existing tests for final proposed widget policy on an independent connection (including non-default 250ms), rejected-save snapshot recovery without draft loss and selected-connector isolation. PR5 integration tests should verify explicit send_on_file_failure=false survives saved settings into abort execution; cached/rejected editor facts cannot authorize runtime delivery; disabled configuration inspection does not permit sending; when SMTP starts advertising working file support, incomplete required limits follow approved requirements-failure behavior. New capability-error metadata is safe BO feedback only, not transcript delivery evidence. No PR2 browser journey rewrite or changed existing expectations is authorized by this audit.

comments.text: Integration matrix expanded through real API/Engine: attested partial uploads across groups yield only confirmed file descriptors and one grouped failure record; uncertain first publication promotes next root with original canonical body once; later upload uncertainty under abort publishes no uploaded prefix; concurrent attempts retain connector/bytes/answer isolation. Existing API tests already cover requirements-error no acquisition, literal-false abort, streamed/integer edit identity, real signed materialization identity/HTTP boundary, selected SMTP for IMAP, callbacks and Engine outage. SMTP integration found and fixed two new-path threading regressions with red tests: preserve immediate parent on first reply, mint new continuation MIME IDs instead of reusing a preminted answer ID. Per-operation continuation context remains on private preparation connection, not Outgoing/Plan. Added exact final-header overflow test proving first confirmed submission survives and later part is not submitted. Guide/module docs updated to actual wired behavior and deferred provider verification. Final focused checks and existing browser validation next.

Combined integration validation passed 149 tests including 12 properties, and mix q. Full existing npm E2E suite launched (599 discovered tests across journey browsers and Storybook) against verified isolated DB zaq_test_e2e_feat_delivery_execution; owned dev Storybook server starts on free port4000, E2E server uses4002. Logs /tmp/zaq-pr5-e2e.log; no new feature E2E source authored. Final UX evidence will use representative persisted local fixtures after existing suite completes. mix.lock still identical to HEAD; no dependency state/pins/publication changes.

Additional integration correctness fix validated with a red/green real API test: confirmed attachment history now uses actual acquired name/MIME/size metadata retained without bytes across upload release, rather than stale source size declarations. Private Result metadata remains excluded from safe_evidence; only confirmed indices/provider IDs and bounded descriptors are reported. Focused run 152 passed (10 properties), mix q passed. Existing real-browser delivery visibility suite passed all 3 engines. Full existing Playwright suite remains running; no new feature E2E authoring.

User explicitly approved required SMTP ceiling rejection in EmailConnectorSettingsTest and matching ChannelConfigTest persistence contract (2026-11-28 chat replies). Empty/incomplete/cleared limits now must reject and preserve persisted settings. Prior explicit valid SMTP fixture limits approval applies to configuration regression fixtures.

Validation: all 109 SMTP configuration tests/property pass; mix q passes. Existing full E2E: 597 passed, 3 skipped in 14.2m. Refreshed existing history journey across three browsers running against latest implementation. Broader SMTP-related suites selected for checking persistence fixture compatibility before UX handoff. No new feature E2E authored.

Manual persisted local browser inspection: mixed, unconfirmed/aborted, all-failed and successful scenes generated through real Channels API/executor/Engine with controlled external adapter; keyboard Enter, Tab containment, Escape and focus restoration work, long file names do not overflow. Found dark modal content inherited browser black; apply existing semantic text-default to modal focus wrapper and recapture. New feature E2E remains gated.

Approved fixture limit updates expanded to SMTP-dependent history, notification, People and connector tests. Shared PeopleAuthDelivery fixture now persists its valid SMTP config before selecting its transport mock, retaining real capability validation and unchanged mock send assertions. Repaired 17-suite run: 418/419 pass, then remaining auth mock setup fixed and all 10 focused auth/modal checks pass. Pending explicit approval covers seven old capability/saved-limit assertions across the three disclosed files; these assertions remain unchanged. Current mix q passes; final precommit remains reserved for after gated E2E/review/coverage per lifecycle.

Latest validation: 3/3 existing delivery-visibility browser journeys pass after final dark modal text correction; mix q passes (1859 files, no issues). Refreshed existing history E2E: 24/24 pass across Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. Full existing E2E earlier 597 passed/3 skipped. 45 People auth/controller regressions pass; 10 focused modal/auth cases pass; Add Config regression passes after approved explicit limits. Seven existing capability/saved-limit assertions remain unchanged pending the explicit three-file approval question; .9 remains in progress, .10/.11 stay open. No Git commits/pushes or dependency changes.
